jobs_assessment_identity.name: jobs_assessment_identity
jobs_assessment_identity.value: ("jobs"."assessment_id" IS NULL AND "jobs"."assessment_received_at" IS NULL) OR ("jobs"."assessment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."assessment_received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."scheduled_at" >= "jobs"."assessment_received_at")

legal_hold_assignments_revocation.name: legal_hold_assignments_revocation
legal_hold_assignments_revocation.value: ("legal_hold_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "legal_hold_assignments"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "legal_hold_assignments"."revoke_reason" IS NULL) OR ("legal_hold_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "legal_hold_assignments"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "legal_hold_assignments"."revoke_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("legal_hold_assignments"."revoke_reason")) > 0 AND octet_length("legal_hold_assignments"."revoke_reason") <= 1000)

legal_holds_release.name: legal_holds_release
legal_holds_release.value: ("legal_holds"."released_at" IS NULL AND "legal_holds"."released_by" IS NULL AND "legal_holds"."release_authority_id" IS NULL AND "legal_holds"."release_reason" IS NULL AND "legal_holds"."legal_review_reference" IS NULL) OR ("legal_holds"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND "legal_holds"."released_by" IS NOT NULL AND "legal_holds"."release_authority_id" IS NOT NULL AND "legal_holds"."release_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("legal_holds"."release_reason")) > 0 AND octet_length("legal_holds"."release_reason") <= 1000 AND ("legal_holds"."legal_review_reference" IS NULL OR (length(trim("legal_holds"."legal_review_reference")) > 0 AND octet_length("legal_holds"."legal_review_reference") <= 300)))

moderator_assignments_revoke_fields.name: moderator_assignments_revoke_fields
moderator_assignments_revoke_fields.value: ("moderator_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "moderator_assignments"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "moderator_assignments"."revoke_reason" IS NULL) OR ("moderator_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "moderator_assignments"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "moderator_assignments"."revoke_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("moderator_assignments"."revoke_reason")) > 0 AND octet_length("moderator_assignments"."revoke_reason") <= 1000)

moderator_change_requests_resolution.name: moderator_change_requests_resolution

moderator_holds_release_fields.name: moderator_holds_release_fields

revision_assessments_deadline.name: revision_assessments_deadline
revision_assessments_deadline.value: ("revision_assessments"."deadline" IS NULL AND "revision_assessments"."wait_milliseconds" IS NULL AND NOT "revision_assessments"."shortcut_requested") OR ("revision_assessments"."deadline" IS NOT NULL AND "revision_assessments"."wait_milliseconds" IS NOT NULL AND "revision_assessments"."wait_milliseconds" BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000 AND "revision_assessments"."deadline" >= "revision_assessments"."received_at")
